senses.zh_definition: 康斯坦丁：源于拉丁人名 Constantinus 的男性名字，见于多种欧洲语言；具体人物须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: A masculine given name derived from Latin Constantinus; its bearer is identified by context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas lelaki yang berasal daripada nama Latin Constantinus; orang yang dirujuk ditentukan oleh konteks.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，不是表示某种行为或性质的普通马来语词。名称的历史来源不等于现代词义，不能把人名直接翻译成“坚定”。以下搭配为教学示例，未核定语料频率。

etymology.historical_story: Konstantin belongs to a European family of personal names descending from Latin Constantinus. Its deeper history connects with constans, expressing steadfastness. Related names travelled through different linguistic and religious traditions, acquiring different spellings and pronunciations. In a Malay sentence, however, Konstantin identifies a person; its historical association does not become an ordinary Malay adjective.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Konstantin 与英文 constant 联想，记住“名字背后有坚定之意”；实际阅读时仍把它当作人名“康斯坦丁”。
